LanguageData.HardyPlants_TemperaturesDesc: Below the minimum a plant stops growing. A hardy plant gets these values only where they are better than its own.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_FrostDesc: Vanilla plants go leafless 10–18 °C below their minimum growth temperature. Hardy plants survive this much more.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_GroupCustom: My own selection (list on the right)
LanguageData.HardyPlants_FasterGrowthDesc: Crops, trees and wild plants – each with its own speed. Works at once for every plant on the map, also for plants that appear later. No restart. Off by default.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_GrowAllDayDesc: Plants do not rest at night, and plants under the open sky also grow in the dark. Plants under a roof still need lamps. Off by default.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_CropDays: Set how long crops take to grow
LanguageData.HardyPlants_TreeDays: Set how long trees take to grow
LanguageData.HardyPlants_DaysDesc: Days at 100 % growth rate. Plants rest at night (unless 24/7 is on) and grow slower in poor light, soil or temperature, so in a real game it takes longer. Applied when this window is closed – no restart. Off by default.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_YieldDesc: How much crops and wild plants give when harvested and how much wood a tree gives. Works at once. Off by default.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_RegrowDesc: How fast wild plants and trees come back on the map after cutting, grazing or fire. Plant density still follows the biome. Plants also come back under snow when it is warm enough for them to grow. Off by default.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_IgnoreSoil: Poor soil does not slow growth
LanguageData.HardyPlants_IgnoreSoilDesc: On sand, gravel and poor soil plants grow at full speed. Rich soil still helps. Where nothing grows, nothing changes. Off by default.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_NoBlightDesc: The blight event no longer happens and blight does not spread. Off by default.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_GrowthNote: Speed, yield, regrowth, soil, blight and 24/7 work at once, grow times after closing this window.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOn: The mod sets itself up and works right away. Ideal for new players and anyone who does not want to tweak anything.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOffSame: Custom settings. Still the same as recommended.
LanguageData.MUI_ConfirmOn: Turn recommended settings on? Your changes ({0}) will be replaced with the recommended values.
LanguageData.MUI_Locked: Detailed settings are locked. Want to change them? Turn off the switch above – your values start from the recommended ones.
LanguageData.MUI_ChangedTip: Differs from the recommended setting ({0}). Click to restore the recommended value.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_PresetVanilla_Card: Growth and yield like the base game.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_ProfRec_Card: Faster growth, bigger harvests and no blight. Still fair.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_PresetLush_Card: Plants everywhere, growing fast day and night.
LanguageData.HardyPlants_ProfileHint: Change anything under Growth or Yield and the profile switches to Custom. Orange CHANGED = differs from recommended, click it to restore.
